scope: CVG-005 local hardening of the tenant-scoped equipment laboratory provider-result ingress

criteria.description: The equipment-result boundary requires strict versioned raw JSON, canonical UTC observedAt, account-bound fresh HMAC-SHA-256 headers and duplicate/unknown/malformed input rejection.
criteria.limitations: The protocol is local evidence and does not homologate a real laboratory provider or transport.

criteria.description: Valid first ingress is durably acknowledged as pending_human_review, replay is stable, divergent reuse conflicts, audit is awaited and the route never mutates or signs a diagnostic order.
criteria.limitations: Human clinical review and any later release/signature workflow remain outside this gate.

criteria.description: The durable repository and migration use the account/external-result boundary for atomic replay/conflict decisions, immutable provider facts, tenant filtering and workflow-only updates.
criteria.limitations: The PostgreSQL proof is disposable local infrastructure; target rollout and production scale are not certified.

criteria.description: The dedicated permission is present in the real first-run catalog, and runtime API/worker roles lose DELETE/TRUNCATE on the append-only laboratory ledger after broad grants, including inherited-role evidence.
criteria.limitations: The ACL evidence covers the repository's disposable PostgreSQL roles and local deployment scripts, not a target cluster.

criteria.description: The bounded implementation passes TDD/API/database regressions, aggregate coverage, workspace quality gates and security/contract validators.
criteria.limitations: The recursive pnpm test attempt was interrupted with exit 130 after local resource saturation and is not counted as a pass; serial PostgreSQL and full API evidence are the accepted bounded regression set.

criteria.description: The initial independent review's P1 clean-install catalog and P2 runtime DELETE/TRUNCATE findings were corrected and directly retested; a fresh reviewer session did not return before the bounded operational timeout.
criteria.limitations: No independent APPROVE_BOUNDED is inferred after the corrections: two delegated review attempts were shut down after no result. Direct tests and integrator inspection remain the basis for this bounded conditional closure.

criteria.description: The local result is reconciled without promoting CVG-005, general/clinical Vetus parity, enterprise readiness, target operations or release acceptance.
criteria.limitations: General parity remains 4/11, clinical parity 2/3 and enterprise readiness 95/100 with 42 PASS, 3 WARN and 1 FAIL.

gaps: No fresh independent approval was returned after the P1/P2 corrections; the gate remains conditional on direct evidence.
Live Lab/provider homologation, external credentials, analyzer mapping, target runtime, production operations, backup/restore, accessibility, LGPD and complete Vetus parity remain open.
The recursive workspace test attempt was interrupted by local resource saturation and is not evidence of a clean full-suite pass.
conditions: Keep CVG-005 and global ERP IN_PROGRESS/PARTIAL and promotion BLOCKED.
Treat the ingress as pending human review only; do not auto-release, auto-sign or mutate diagnostic orders.
Obtain a fresh independent review before using this slice as a release or production approval.
Revalidate before changing payload/signing semantics, adding providers, using external credentials or enabling target/production behavior.

next_action: Keep the bounded result conditional until a fresh independent review is obtained; then begin fresh scouting under a new authority while global ERP remains IN_PROGRESS/PARTIAL and promotion BLOCKED.
